prompts.label: direct invocation
prompts.prompt: Run ep-fix on the latest audit. Do not commit.

prompts.label: low-risk batch
prompts.prompt: Apply all unstarted low-risk items. Stop on scope creep.

prompts.label: decision pass
prompts.prompt: Work through requires_decision items in 2026-08-10. Ask before each source change.

prompts.label: interrupted fix
prompts.prompt: Resume audit remediation. One item is in_progress with a partial diff.

prompts.label: by category
prompts.prompt: Fix only the imports and types action items from docs/audit/2026-08-10.

prompts.label: specific ids
prompts.prompt: Execute 003 and 004 from the current audit run. Verify before marking done.

prompts.label: per-item commit
prompts.prompt: Apply remaining items and auto-commit each one separately.

prompts.label: ambiguous wording
prompts.prompt: Land the engineering-principles action items that are still in the run root.

prompts.label: discover not fix
prompts.prompt: Find DRY and boundary violations. Do not change source.

prompts.label: advisory review
prompts.prompt: Write an architecture review. Do not apply audit items.

prompts.label: unrelated refactor
prompts.prompt: Extract a UserService class. There is no audit action item.

prompts.label: advice only
prompts.prompt: How should I triage audit action items? Don't edit files.

prompts.label: pr review
prompts.prompt: Review the open pull request for bugs.

prompts.label: dependency bump
prompts.prompt: Upgrade TypeScript to the latest version.

prompts.label: delete audit files
prompts.prompt: Delete docs/audit/ so we can start over.
